ayahs.textArabic: حٰمۤ  ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Ḥā mīm.
ayahs.textEnglish: Ha. Mim.

ayahs.textArabic: تَنْزِيْلُ الْكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الْعَزِيْزِ الْحَكِيْمِ
ayahs.textLatin: Tanzīlul-kitābi minallāhil-‘azīzil-ḥakīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: THE BESTOWAL from on high of this divine writ issues from God, the Almighty, the Wise.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi la'āyātil lil-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, in the heavens as well as on earth there are indeed messages for all who [are willing to] believe.

ayahs.textArabic: وَفِيْ خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِنْ دَاۤبَّةٍ اٰيٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُّوْقِنُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa fī khalqikum wa mā yabuṡṡu min dābbatin āyātul liqaumiy yūqinūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And in your own nature, and in [that of] all the animals which He scatters [over the earth] there are messages for people who are endowed with inner certainty.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاخْتِلَافِ الَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ مِنَ السَّمَاۤءِ مِنْ رِّزْقٍ فَاَحْيَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيْفِ الرِّيٰحِ اٰيٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يَّعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wakhtilāfil-laili wan-nahāri wa mā anzalallāhu minas-samā'i mir rizqin fa aḥyā bihil-arḍa ba‘da mautihā wa taṣrīfir-riyāḥi āyātul liqaumiy ya‘qilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And in the succession of night and day, and in the means of subsistence which God sends down from the skies, giving life thereby to the earth after it had been lifeless, and in the change of the winds: [in all this] there are messages for people who use their reason.

ayahs.textArabic: تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ اللّٰهِ نَتْلُوْهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّۚ فَبِاَيِّ حَدِيْثٍۢ بَعْدَ اللّٰهِ وَاٰيٰتِهٖ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Tilka āyātullāhi natlūhā ‘alaika bil-ḥaqq(i), fa bi'ayyi ḥadīṡim ba‘dallāhi wa āyātihī yu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: These messages of God do We convey unto thee, setting forth the truth. In what other tiding, if not in God’s messages, will they, then, believe?

ayahs.textArabic: وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ اَفَّاكٍ اَثِيْمٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wailul likulli affākin aṡīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Woe unto every sinful self-deceiver

ayahs.textArabic: يَّسْمَعُ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ تُتْلٰى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَاَنْ لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَاۚ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Yasma‘u āyātillāhi tutlā ‘alaihi ṡumma yuṣirru mustakbiran ka'allam yasma‘hā, fa basysyirhu bi‘ażābin alīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: who hears God’s messages when they are conveyed to him, and yet, as though he had not heard them, persists in his haughty disdain! Hence, announce unto him grievous suffering –

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ اٰيٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا ۨاتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًاۗ اُولٰۤىِٕكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِيْنٌۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā ‘alima min āyātinā syai'anittakhażahā huzuwā(n), ulā'ika lahum ‘ażābum muhīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: for when he does become aware of any of Our messages, he makes them a target of his mockery! For all such there is shameful suffering in store.

ayahs.textArabic: مِنْ وَّرَاۤىِٕهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۚوَلَا يُغْنِيْ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَسَبُوْا شَيْـًٔا وَّلَا مَا اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اَوْلِيَاۤءَۚ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيْمٌۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Miw warā'ihim jahannam(u), wa lā yugnī ‘anhum mā kasabū syai'aw wa lā mattakhażū min dūnillāhi auliyā'(a), wa lahum ‘ażābun ‘aẓīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hell is ahead of them; and all that they may have gained [in this world] shall be of no avail whatever to them, and neither shall any of those things which, instead of God, they have come to regard as their protectors: for, awesome suffering awaits them.

ayahs.textArabic: هٰذَا هُدًىۚ وَالَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّنْ رِّجْزٍ اَلِيْمٌ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Hāżā hudā(n), wal-lażīna kafarū bi'āyāti rabbihim lahum ‘ażābum mir rijzin alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: [To pay heed to God’s signs and messages:] this is [the meaning of] guidance; on the other hand, for those who are bent on denying the truth of their Sustainer’s messages there is grievous suffering in store as an outcome of [their] vileness.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ فِيْهِ بِاَمْرِهٖ وَلِتَبْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Allāhul-lażī sakhkhara  lakumul-baḥra litajriyal-fulku fīhi bi'amrihī wa litabtagū min faḍlihī wa la‘allakum tasykurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: IT IS GOD who has made the sea subservient [to His laws, so that it be of use] to you so that ships might sail through it at His behest, and that you might seek to obtain [what you need] of His bounty, and that you might have cause to be grateful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمْ مَّا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الْاَرْضِ جَمِيْعًا مِّنْهُ ۗاِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa sakhkhara lakum mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍi jamī‘am minh(u), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yatafakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And He has made subservient to you, [as a gift] from Himself, all that is in the heavens and on earth: in this, behold, there are messages indeed for people who think!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ لِّلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا يَغْفِرُوْا لِلَّذِيْنَ لَا يَرْجُوْنَ اَيَّامَ اللّٰهِ لِيَجْزِيَ قَوْمًا ۢبِمَا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul lil-lażīna āmanū yagfirū lil-lażīna lā yarjūna ayyāmallāhi liyajziya qaumam bimā kānū yaksibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Tell all who have attained to faith that they should forgive those who do not believe in the com­ing of the Days of God, [since it is] for Him [alone] to requite people for whatever they may have earned.

ayahs.textArabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهٖۚ وَمَنْ اَسَاۤءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۖ ثُمَّ اِلٰى رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Man ‘amila ṣāliḥan fa linafsih(ī), wa man asā'a fa ‘alaihā, ṡumma ilā rabbikum turja‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Whoever does what is just and right, does so for his own good; and whoever does evil, does so to his own hurt; and in the end unto your Sustainer you all will be brought back.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ الْكِتٰبَ وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنٰهُمْ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنٰهُمْ عَلَى الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad ātainā banī isrā'īlal-kitāba wal-ḥukma wan-nubuwwata wa razaqnāhum minaṭ-ṭayyibāti wa faḍḍalnāhum ‘alal-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND, INDEED, [already] unto the children of Israel did We vouchsafe revelation, and wisdom, and prophethood; and We provided for them sustenance out of the good things of life, and favoured them above all other people [of their time].

ayahs.textArabic: وَاٰتَيْنٰهُمْ بَيِّنٰتٍ مِّنَ الْاَمْرِۚ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوْٓا اِلَّا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَاۤءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًاۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۗاِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِيْ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ فِيْمَا كَانُوْا فِيْهِ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ātaināhum bayyinātim minal-amr(i), fa makhtalafū illā mim ba‘di mā jā'ahumul-‘ilmu bagyam bainahum, inna rabbaka yaqḍī bainahum yaumal-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And We gave them clear indications of the purpose [of faith]; and it was only after all this knowledge had been vouchsafed to them that they began, out of mutual jealousy, to hold divergent views: [but,] verily, thy Sustainer will judge be­tween them on Resurrection Day regarding all whereon they were wont to differ.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنٰكَ عَلٰى شَرِيْعَةٍ مِّنَ الْاَمْرِ فَاتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ اَهْوَاۤءَ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma ja‘alnāka ‘alā syarī‘atim minal-amri fattabi‘hā wa lā tattabi‘ ahwā'al-lażīna lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, finally, [O Muhammad,] We have set thee on a way by which the purpose [of faith] may be fulfilled: so follow thou this [way], and follow not the likes and dislikes of those who do not know [the truth].

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يُّغْنُوْا عَنْكَ مِنَ اللّٰهِ شَيْـًٔا  ۗوَاِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ بَعْضُهُمْ اَوْلِيَاۤءُ بَعْضٍۚ وَاللّٰهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Innahum lay yugnū ‘anka minallāhi syai'ā(n), wa innaẓ-ẓālimīna ba‘ḍuhum auliyā'u ba‘ḍ(in), wallāhu waliyyul-muttaqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, they could never be of any avail to thee if thou wert to defy the will of God for, verily, such evildoers are but friends and protectors of one another, whereas God is the Protector of all who are conscious of Him.

ayahs.textArabic: هٰذَا بَصَاۤىِٕرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَّرَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُّوْقِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Hāżā baṣā'iru lin-nāsi wa hudaw wa raḥmatul liqaumiy yūqinūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: This [revelation, then,] is a means of insight for mankind, and a guidance and grace unto people who are endowed with inner certainty.

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِيْنَ اجْتَرَحُوا السَّيِّاٰتِ اَنْ نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ سَوَاۤءً مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۗسَاۤءَ مَا يَحْكُمُوْنَ ࣖࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Am ḥasibal-lażīnajtaraḥus -sayyi'āti an naj‘alahum kal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti sawā'am maḥyāhum wa mamātuhum, sā'a mā yaḥkumūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now as for those who indulge in sinful doings - do they think that We place them, both in their life and their death, on an equal footing with those who have attained to faith and do righteous deeds? Bad, indeed, is their judgment:

ayahs.textArabic: وَخَلَقَ اللّٰهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزٰى كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa khalaqallāhus-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqqi wa litujzā kullu nafsim bimā kasabat wa hum lā yuẓlamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, God has created the heavens and the earth in accordance with [an inner] truth, and [has therefore willed] that every human being shall be recompensed for what he has earned and none shall be wronged.

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰهَهٗ هَوٰىهُ وَاَضَلَّهُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى عِلْمٍ وَّخَتَمَ عَلٰى سَمْعِهٖ وَقَلْبِهٖ وَجَعَلَ عَلٰى بَصَرِهٖ غِشٰوَةًۗ فَمَنْ يَّهْدِيْهِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ اللّٰهِ ۗ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Afa ra'aita manittakhaża ilāhahū hawāhu wa aḍallahullāhu ‘alā ‘ilmiw wa khatama ‘alā sam‘ihī wa qalbihī wa ja‘ala ‘alā baṣarihī gisyāwah(tan), famay yahdīhi mim ba‘dillāh(i), afalā tażakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: HAST THOU ever considered [the kind of man] who makes his own desires his deity, and whom God has [thereupon] let go astray, knowing [that his mind is closed to all guidance], and whose hearing and heart He has sealed, and upon whose sight He has placed a veil? Who, then, could guide him after God [has abandoned him]? Will you not, then, bethink your­selves?

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْا مَا هِيَ اِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوْتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَآ اِلَّا الدَّهْرُۚ وَمَا لَهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۚ اِنْ هُمْ اِلَّا يَظُنُّوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū mā hiya illā ḥayātunad-dun-yā namūtu wa naḥyā wa mā yuhlikunā illad-dahr(u), wa mā lahum biżālika min ‘ilmin in hum illā yaẓunnūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And yet they say: “There is nothing beyond our life in this world. We die as we come to life, and nothing but time destroys us.” But of this they have no knowledge whatever: they do nothing but guess.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا تُتْلٰى عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ اِلَّآ اَنْ قَالُوا ائْتُوْا بِاٰبَاۤىِٕنَآ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā tutlā ‘alaihim āyātunā bayyinātim mā kāna ḥujjatahum illā an qālu'tū bi'ābā'inā in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [so,] whenever Our messages are conveyed to them in all their clarity, their only argument is this: “Bring forth our fore­fathers [as witnesses], if what you claim is true!”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلِ اللّٰهُ يُحْيِيْكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيْتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ اِلٰى يَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِ لَارَيْبَ فِيْهِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Qulillāhu yuḥyīkum ṡumma yumītukum ṡumma yajma‘ukum ilā yaumil-qiyāmati lā raiba fīhi wa lākinna akṡaran-nāsi lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “It is God who gives you life, and then causes you to die; and in the end He will gather you together on Resurrection Day, [the coming of] which is beyond all doubt - but most human beings under­stand it not.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِلّٰهِ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِۗ وَيَوْمَ تَقُوْمُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ يَّخْسَرُ الْمُبْطِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lillāhi mulkus-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), wa yauma taqūmus-sā‘atu yauma'iżiy yakhsarul-mubṭilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: For, God’s is the dominion over the heavens and the earth; and on the Day when the Last Hour dawns - on that Day will be lost all who [in their lifetime] tried to reduce to nothing [whatever they could not understand].

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَرٰى كُلَّ اُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً ۗ كُلُّ اُمَّةٍ تُدْعٰٓى اِلٰى كِتٰبِهَاۗ  اَلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa tarā kulla ummatin jāṡiyah(tan), kullu ummatin tud‘ā ilā kitābihā, al-yauma tujzauna mā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [on that Day] thou wilt see all people kneeling down [in humility]: all people will be called upon to [face] their record: “Today you shall be requited for all that you ever did!

ayahs.textArabic: هٰذَا كِتٰبُنَا يَنْطِقُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ ۗاِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنْسِخُ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Hāżā kitābunā yanṭiqu ‘alaikum bil-ḥaqq(i), innā kunnā nastansikhu mā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: This Our record speaks of you in all truth: for, verily, We have caused to be recorded all that you ever did!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ  فِيْ رَحْمَتِهٖۗ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْمُبِيْنُ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa'ammal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti fayudkhiluhum rabbuhum fī raḥmatih(ī), żālika huwal-fauzul-mubīn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now as for those who have attained to faith and done righteous deeds, their Sustainer will admit them to His grace: that will be [their] manifest triumph!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْاۗ  اَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ اٰيٰتِيْ تُتْلٰى عَلَيْكُمْ فَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ammal-lażīna kafarū, falam takun āyātī tutlā ‘alaikum fastakbartum wa kuntum qaumam mujrimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But as for those who were bent on denying the truth, [they will be told:] “Were not My messages conveyed to you? And withal, you gloried in your arrogance, and so you became people lost in sin:

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّالسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيْهَا قُلْتُمْ مَّا نَدْرِيْ مَا السَّاعَةُۙ اِنْ نَّظُنُّ اِلَّا ظَنًّا وَّمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā qīla inna wa‘dallāhi ḥaqquw was-sā‘atu lā raiba fīhā qultum mā nadrī mas-sā‘ah(tu), in naẓunnu illā ẓannaw wa mā naḥnu bimustaiqinīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for when it was said, ‘Behold, God’s promise always comes true, and there can be no doubt about [the coming of] the Last Hour’ - you would answer, ‘We do not know what that Last Hour may be: we think it is no more than an empty guess, and [so] we are by no means convinced!’”

ayahs.textArabic: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا عَمِلُوْا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa badā lahum sayyi'ātu mā ‘amilū wa ḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [on that Day,] the evil of their doings will become obvious to them, and they will be over­whelmed by the very thing which they were wont to deride.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقِيْلَ الْيَوْمَ نَنْسٰىكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيْتُمْ لِقَاۤءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هٰذَاۙ وَمَأْوٰىكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qīlal-yauma nansākum kamā nasītum liqā'a yaumikum hāżā, wa ma'wākumun nāru wa mā lakum min nāṣirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [the word] will be spoken: “Today We shall be oblivious of you as you were oblivious of the coming of this your Day [of Judgment]; and so your goal is the fire, and you shall have none to succour you:

ayahs.textArabic: ذٰلِكُمْ بِاَنَّكُمُ اتَّخَذْتُمْ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ هُزُوًا وَّغَرَّتْكُمُ الْحَيٰوةُ الدُّنْيَا ۚفَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُوْنَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Żālikum bi'annakumuttakhażtum āyātillāhi huzuwaw wa garratkumul-ḥayātud-dun-yā, fal-yauma lā yukhrajūna minhā wa lā hum yusta‘tabūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: this, because you made God’s messages the target of your mockery, having allowed the life of this world to beguile you!” On that Day, therefore, they will not be brought out of the fire, nor will they be allowed to make amends.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلِلّٰهِ الْحَمْدُ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَرَبِّ الْاَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa lillāhil-ḥamdu rabbis-samāwāti wa rabbil-arḍi rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND THUS, all praise is due to God, Sustainer of the heavens and Sustainer of the earth: the Sustainer of all the worlds!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَهُ الْكِبْرِيَاۤءُ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ ۗوَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ ࣖ   ۔
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lahul-kibriyā'u fis-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), wa huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: And His alone is all majesty in the heavens and on earth; and He alone is almighty, truly wise!
